tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent, fail, warn.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, code blocks and inputs sitting on surface-0. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover fill, raised rows, selected line. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers between sections. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (buttons, inputs, checkboxes) and chart axes; at least 3:1 on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, line numbers and placeholders on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand color, a muted steel blue: prompt glyphs, links, focus rings, primary fills, progress. As text on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet accent background: selected item, current lesson. Text on it: ink and accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an accent or accent-strong fill. Not for use on any other ground.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Passing check. Always paired with the glyph ✓ and the word pass; shares the accent hue, so it never relies on hue alone.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Failing check, error text and flagged review lines on surface-0, surface-1, surface-2 and fail-subtle. Always paired with ✗ and the word fail. Orange against the blue accent stays distinguishable for red-green color blindness.

tokens.name: fail-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a failing check or a flagged line in a code review. Text on it: ink and fail.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings and hints on surface-0, surface-1, surface-2 and warn-subtle. Always paired with ! and the word hint or warn.

tokens.name: warn-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of a hint. Text on it: ink and warn.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Language keywords in code blocks, on surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: String literals in code blocks, on surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: syn-function
tokens.usage: Function and type names in code blocks, on surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Numbers and constants in code blocks, on surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Comments in code blocks, on surface-1.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and cover titles. Lowercase, one per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles and the lesson title.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Meta lines and field labels. Set in lowercase or with the letter-spacing shown.

styles.name: gutter
styles.usage: Line numbers in the gutter of a code block.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact controls and between check lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Code blocks, cards and the cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Popovers and dialogs, the largest radius in the system.
